evidence_claims.claim: Shock occurs via a complete path involving the body, not necessarily soil
evidence_claims.limitations: Training binder funded by OSHA but not authored by OSHA; exact pathway depends on source topology.

evidence_claims.claim: Shock severity depends on current, path, duration and contact conditions including moisture

supports.location: Section 3 key points on path, current, time, moisture
Scope only: physiological effects of shock current

evidence_claims.limitations: No safe human-current threshold determined; full IEC text and clinical review outstanding.

evidence_claims.claim: Injury may involve burns and falls as well as shock

supports.location: Section 3 electrical, arc, thermal burns and falls

evidence_claims.limitations: Actual injury evaluation requires medical professionals.

evidence_claims.claim: Touch voltage is between simultaneously contacted accessible points
evidence_claims.limitations: Exact touch voltage assessment requires qualified site measurement and topology.

evidence_claims.claim: Step voltage around a ground fault is a potentially hazardous difference

supports.location: Electrical incidents pages: downed high-voltage power lines and contact danger

evidence_claims.limitations: Additional specialized utility/public-safety source required before claim is treated as fully corroborated.

evidence_claims.claim: A conventional overcurrent breaker is not general personnel shock protection

supports.location: GFCI personnel protection versus conventional overcurrent

evidence_claims.limitations: No fixed universal threshold for every device or body condition.

evidence_claims.claim: Line-neutral contact may not trip a residual-current device

supports.location: RCD is supplemental and not universal

evidence_claims.limitations: Specific device and source arrangement determine detected imbalance.

evidence_claims.claim: PE and neutral have different intended functions
evidence_claims.limitations: No universal conductor color or topology assumption.

evidence_claims.claim: Open neutral may still be energized
evidence_claims.limitations: Cannot generalize to measured potential of every neutral.

evidence_claims.claim: Safe work needs source isolation and verification including backfeed
evidence_claims.limitations: Workplace regulation; no homeowner procedure or proof of home-specific compliance.

evidence_claims.claim: Emergency responders should avoid touching an electrically energized person
evidence_claims.limitations: Use local emergency number and dispatcher; no improvised high-voltage rescue.

evidence_claims.claim: Electrical injury merits medical evaluation after harmful contact

supports.location: When to call doctor and care

evidence_claims.limitations: Severity triage requires medical professional; no diagnosis from lecture.

evidence_review.scope: claim-level checks of public explanations, regulatory provisions, published standards scope and selected engineering material; original calculations cross-checked
evidence_review.claim_level_corroboration: Partial; individual claim entries identify evidence and gaps
